exposure: Planned birth in Midwife-led birth centres (MLBCs)
Intrapartum and childbirth care in MLBCs
outcome: Maternal outcomes (spontaneous vaginal births, caesarean births, operative vaginal births, severe postpartum haemorrhages)
Neonatal outcomes (Apgar scores < 7 at 5 min, neonatal death)
cohort: The cohort consisted of women with a planned birth in one of the eight French Midwife-led Birth Centres between 2018 and 2019.
finding: French Midwife-led Birth Centres, with appropriate selection of women and low-intervention care, achieve salutogenic maternal and neonatal outcomes, and risk factors for transfers were identified.
mod_finding: The study found high rates of spontaneous vaginal births (90.8%), with lower rates of caesarean (2.6%) and operative vaginal births (6.6%).
